text:
Maya: Heads-up — I just noticed that accounts with the 'support_read' role can access the admin usage/costs page in prod. Repro in ~2 mins, attaching minimal steps. Not sure if this is a mapping/regression from yesterday's RBAC refactor.

Kevin: Yikes. Can you paste the exact curl and response fragments?

Maya: Repro steps:
1) Create session with a token scoped to role 'support_read'
2) GET https://console.redwood.internal/api/admin/usage?team_id=acme
3) Response 200 with payload containing per-customer costs and usage buckets (should 403).

Example:
```
GET /api/admin/usage?team_id=acme HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <support-token>

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{
  "team_id": "acme",
  "costs": {"total": 1245.23, "by_day": [...]},
  "internal_meta": {"ingested_by": "analytics-svc"}
}
```

Onyeka: That sounds like the billing_view -> costs_read mapping we pushed yesterday; if the default mapping accidentally granted admin_tier to legacy roles that could explain it. Which deploy contained the RBAC mapping change?

deploy-bot: Deployed console-service sha: abcd1234 at 2024-03-07T08:12:04Z (role-mapping refactor).

Chris: Immediate mitigation: add a deny rule for /api/admin/usage to role 'support_read' and revert mapping. Also rotate any long-lived support tokens and add an ACL in the API gateway. I'll stand up a temporary WAF rule blocking requests with support tokens to that endpoint. :eyes:

Kevin: I'll add an audit hook and export last 24h of access logs to the sec-sandbox. Also check whether the data returned includes customer PII (shouldn't) and whether the costs are encrypted at rest with our KMS keys — if KMS keys were accessible we escalate.

Maya: Audit logs already show calls from support-service-account at 08:18:12 and 08:19:03. Payloads include customer_id and aggregated costs but not raw PII. Marking severity P2 for now, might go P1 if we find exfil.

Onyeka: Creating INC-4321 (rbac-billing-exposure). Assigning to sec-eng and infra. I'll open a PR to rollback the mapping change and a follow-up to tighten the policy matrix. Please add repro logs to the incident ticket.

security-bot: Incident INC-4321 created and paged oncall.

Maya: I'll scrub sample payloads from logs (remove customer_id) and rotate the DEK for the analytics bucket as a precaution. Will update the incident when done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
